indicators.name: Bed Occupancy Rate
indicators.numerator: Total Patient bed days (Midnight head count of each day added for the month of all patients) Exclusion – New-borns in Maternity Wards and Day Care Patients
indicators.denominator: Product of Total number of functional beds in the hospital and days in the month Exclusion:- Labour Room Tables and Observation Beds
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total Patient bed days *100/Functional beds*days in month)
indicators.significance: Indicator for Utilization of Hospital Indoor services

indicators.name: Lab test done per thousand patients
indicators.numerator: Total number of tests done for both OPD and IPD patients Exclusion - Test done at Point of care
indicators.denominator: Total number of patients attended during the month Inclusion:- Both OPD and IPD cases
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total number of lab tests done*1000/Total number of patients attended)
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure Utilization of laboratory services

indicators.name: Percentage of cases of High Risk Pregnancy/obstetric complication out of total registered pregnancies at the facilities
indicators.numerator: Total number of high risk pregnancies registered at the facility Inclusion:-Severe Anaemia ,PPH, PIH/Eclampsia/Pre Eclampsia, Retained Placenta, HIV Positive Pregnant women, Septic Cases, Obstructed labour including C- Section Exclude:- Referral without any interventions
indicators.denominator: Total number of obstetric cases admitted in the hospital
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of complicated pregnancies registered at the facility*100/Total Obs admissions
indicators.source_of_data: Labour Room Register, OT Register, Indoor Registers
indicators.significance: Indicator for preparedness and utilization of EMoC services

indicators.name: Percentage of surgeries done in night out of total surgeries
indicators.numerator: Total major surgeries conducted during night including LSCS (8 PM to 8 AM) Exclusion – Minor Surgeries
indicators.denominator: Total major surgeries conducted in Hospital (Day+Night) Exclusion – Minor Surgeries
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of major surgeries conducted in night time*100/Total number of major surgeries conducted
indicators.significance: Preparation of OT at night time for major surgeries

indicators.name: Percentage of surgeries done during day out of total surgeries
indicators.numerator: Total number of planned major surgeries conducted during day time (8 AM TO 8 PM)
indicators.denominator: Total major surgeries conducted in Hospital (Day+Night)
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of planned major surgeries conducted*100/Total number of major surgeries
indicators.significance: Preparation of OT for planned surgeries

indicators.name: C-Section Rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of C-section delivery conducted
indicators.denominator: Total deliveries conducted
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of C-section deliveries conducted*100/ Total number of deliveries conducted
indicators.significance: To check utilization of Hospital for C-section deliveries

indicators.name: Emergency Death Rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of deaths in emergency Exclusion:- Brought dead
indicators.denominator: Total number of registered patients in emergency Exclusion - Cases referred out
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of deaths in emergency*100/Total number of registered patients in emergency
indicators.significance: To check efficiency of Emergency department

indicators.name: Referral Out Rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of patients referred from the facility Inclusion:- Emergency and indoor cases Exclusion:- LAMA & absconding
indicators.denominator: Total admission in the facility Exclusion:- Day care Procedures
indicators.formula_or_operator: (No of cases referred out from the hospital*100/ Total no. of cases admitted)
indicators.significance: Indicator for efficiency of clinical process

indicators.name: Major Surgeries per surgeon
indicators.numerator: Total number of major surgeries conducted
indicators.denominator: Total number of surgeons appointed in the facility Inclusion:- Ortho, Gynae, Obs, General surgeon, EMOC trained doctors
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of major surgeries conducted/Total number of surgeons appointed
indicators.significance: Indicator for efficiency of Surgeons

indicators.name: OPD Per doctor
indicators.numerator: Total number of patients attended in OPD
indicators.denominator: Total number of doctors available in the hospital Inclusion: Regular, contractual, Part Time Exclusion:- Doctors not engaged in OPD like MS, Radiologist, Microbiologist
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of Patient consulted in OPD/Total number of doctor appointed for OPD
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of Doctors in OPD

indicators.name: External Quality Score for Lab tests(Median Value)
indicators.formula_or_operator: Take Median of all scores obtained (Arrange scores in increasing order- Pick the middle value if numbers are odd- Take average of middle two values if numbers are even)
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure efficiency of Lab

indicators.name: Percentage of stock out of vital drugs (RMNCH+A)
indicators.numerator: Total stock outs occurred for essential commodities each day added for the month Inclusion – List of vital drugs(RMNCH+A)
indicators.denominator: Product of Total no. of Commodities and days in the month
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total no. of Stock out days for Essential Commodities*100/ Total no. of commodities*Days in Month
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure efficiency of Hospital to ensure availability of vital drugs under RMNCH+A

indicators.name: Maternal death rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of maternal deaths during the month
indicators.denominator: Total number of pregnant women admitted
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total maternal deaths*100/Total admission
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure clinical care of maternity cases

indicators.name: Neonatal death rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of neonatal deaths Inclusion – Neonate died during first 28 days while admitted in the hospital including Out borns admitted in neonate ward/SNCU Exclusion – Still Birth
indicators.denominator: Total no. of neonates admitted including live births in Hospital and out born admissions

indicators.name: Percentage of cases for which maternal death review done
indicators.numerator: Total number of maternal deaths review done during the month
indicators.denominator: Total number of maternal deaths occurred
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of maternal death review done*100/Total number of maternal deaths
indicators.significance: Indicator of adherence to maternal death review process

indicators.name: Average length of stay
indicators.numerator: Total Patient bed days (Midnight head count of each day added for the month of all patients)
indicators.denominator: Total number of discharges. Inclusion:- Normal discharge, LAMA, Abscond, Referral, deaths

indicators.name: Surgical site infection rate

indicators.name: Percentage of mortality out of total SNCU admissions

indicators.name: Number of deaths after Sterilization

indicators.name: Blood Replacement Rate

indicators.name: Left against Medical advice (LAMA) Rate

indicators.formula_or_operator: Mean of waiting time for the derived sample observed in time motion study done at peak hours on sample basis (at least 5% patients but not less than 30)
indicators.significance: To observe waiting time at registration counter

indicators.name: Waiting time at ANC Clinic
indicators.numerator: Waiting time at ANC clinic will be the moment patient entered in Queue for ANC to finally being consulted by MO
indicators.formula_or_operator: Mean of waiting time for the derived sample observed in time motion study done at peak hours on sample basis (at least 5% patients but not less than 30)
indicators.significance: To observe waiting time at ANC Clinic

indicators.name: Waiting time at General OPD
indicators.numerator: Waiting time at General OPD will be the moment patient entered in Queue to finally being consulted by MO
indicators.formula_or_operator: Mean of waiting time for the derived sample observed in time motion study done at peak hours on sample basis (at least 5% patients but not less than 30)
indicators.significance: To observe waiting time at General OPD

indicators.name: Waiting time at Paediatric clinic
indicators.numerator: Waiting time at paediatric OPD will be the moment patient entered in Queue to finally being consulted by MO
indicators.formula_or_operator: Mean of waiting time for the derived sample observed in time motion study done at peak hours on sample basis (at least 5% patients but not less than 30)
indicators.significance: To observe waiting time at Paediatric Clinic

indicators.name: Waiting time at Surgical clinic
indicators.numerator: Waiting time at Surgical OPD will be the moment patient entered in Queue to finally being consulted by MO
indicators.formula_or_operator: Mean of waiting time for the derived sample observed in time motion study done at peak hours on sample basis (at least 5% patients but not less than 30)
indicators.significance: To observe waiting time at Surgical Clinic

indicators.name: Average door to Drug time
indicators.numerator: Time taken by a patient from entering in queue for OPD registration to finally getting drugs at drug dispensing counter
indicators.formula_or_operator: Mean of waiting time for the derived sample observed in time motion study done at peak hours on sample basis (at least 5% patients but not less than 30)
indicators.significance: To observe overall OPD Delivery services

indicators.name: Normal Deliveries per 1000 Population
indicators.numerator: Total number of normal deliveries conducted in the month
indicators.denominator: Total Population= Total population in defined geographical area of the DH
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total number of normal deliveries conducted*1000/Total Population)
indicators.significance: Utilization of Labour room

indicators.name: Proportion of Deliveries conducted at night
indicators.numerator: Total number of deliveries conducted during night time from 8PM to 8AM Inclusion: Normal, assisted, forceps. Exclusion- C-section conducted in OT
indicators.denominator: Total deliveries conducted
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of deliveries conducted at night time/Total number of deliveries conducted in labour room
indicators.significance: Utilization of Labour Room at night

indicators.name: Proportion of complicated cases managed
indicators.numerator: Total number of complicated deliveries managed at the facility Inclusion:-Severe Anaemia ,PPH, PIH/Eclampsia/Pre Eclampsia, Retained Placenta, HIV Positive Pregnant women, Septic Cases, Obstructed labour including C- Section Exclude:- Referral without any interventions
indicators.denominator: Total deliveries conducted
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of complicated pregnancies managed at the facility/Total number of deliveries conducted
indicators.significance: Utilization of Labour Room for complicated deliveries

indicators.name: Proportion assisted delivery conducted
indicators.numerator: Total number of assisted delivery conducted. Inclusion:- Baby needs help to be born with instruments( Forceps or vacuum extractor) Exclusion- C-section and normal delivery
indicators.denominator: Total deliveries conducted
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of assisted deliveries conducted/ Total number of deliveries conducted
indicators.significance: To check utilization of labour room for assisted deliveries

indicators.name: % PPIUCD inserted against total IUCD
indicators.numerator: Total number of PPIUCD cases inserted during the month Inclusion:-Post placental insertion within 10 minutes after placenta expulsion, Intracaesarian insertion before closing the uterine incision, Pre discharge insertion from 10 minutes to 48 hours postpartum.
indicators.denominator: Total IUCD inserted
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total number of PPIUCD inserted*100/Total number of IUCD inserted)
indicators.source_of_data: Family Planning Register/ PPIUCD Register/Labour Room Register
indicators.significance: To check utilization of PPIUCD method for contraception

indicators.name: Proportion of BPL Deliveries
indicators.numerator: Total number of BPL Patients delivered in labour room. Inclusion:- Patients having BPL card/ equivalent card
indicators.denominator: Total deliveries conducted
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total Number of BPL Patient delivered in labour room/Total Deliveries conducted)
indicators.significance: Indicator to see Utilization of labour room by BPL patients

indicators.name: Proportion of cases referred to OT
indicators.numerator: Total number of cases sent to OT from labour Room
indicators.denominator: Total deliveries conducted
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of Patient referred to OT/Total deliveries conducted in labour room
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of Labour Room

indicators.name: Proportion of cases referred to higher facilities
indicators.numerator: Total number of cases referred to higher centre Including cases with or without any management or intervention in labour room
indicators.denominator: Total number of delivery cases attended in labour room
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of Patient referred to higher facilities/Total number of delivered cases attended in labour room
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of Labour Room for all cases

indicators.name: % of new-borns required resuscitation out of total live births
indicators.numerator: Total number of new-borns required resuscitation after birth in labour room
indicators.denominator: Total live births
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total number of new-borns resuscitated*100/Total number of live births)
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of Resuscitation services in Labour room

indicators.name: Proportion of cases partograph maintained
indicators.numerator: Total number of delivery cases where partograph filled completely Exclusion:- Partial or incomplete filled partograph
indicators.denominator: Total number of deliveries conducted Inclusion:- Cases shifted to OT
indicators.formula_or_operator: Number of delivery cases partograph recorded/Total number of deliveries conducted
indicators.source_of_data: Case sheet with Partograph/Labour Room Register
indicators.significance: Indicator of adherence to Labour Room Clinical Protocol

indicators.name: Episiotomy site infection rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of cases with any purulent discharge, abscess, or spreading cellulitis at the episiotomy site after the episiotomy ,Including cases detected within 30 days of procedure
indicators.denominator: Total number of epistomy performed
indicators.formula_or_operator: Number of episiotomy site infection observed/total number of episiotomy done
indicators.significance: Indicator for Quality of infection control practices in labour room

indicators.name: Number of adverse events per thousand patients
indicators.numerator: Total number of adverse events Inclusion:- Needle stick injury, new-born theft/swapping, Mother and new-born falls, Medication error, animal/rodent bites
indicators.denominator: Total admission in Labour room
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total number of incidences of adverse events*1000/ Total Number of admission)
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure safe clinical practises in Labour Room

indicators.name: Culture surveillance sterility rate
indicators.numerator: Total Number of swab culture reported positive
indicators.denominator: Total number of swab sent for culture
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Number of swab culture reported positive*100/Total number of swabs sent for culture from labour room for the month)
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure safe infection control practices in the labour room

indicators.name: Proportion of cases of different complications
indicators.numerator: Total number of PPH or Septicaemia or Obstructed labour or eclampsia or PIH cases managed
indicators.denominator: Total number of complicated deliveries managed
indicators.formula_or_operator: Proportion of individual complications with respect to total number of complications managed at labour room PPH, Septicaemia, Obstructed labour, eclampsia, PIH others
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure community anticipation about the efficiency of facility for complicated cases

indicators.name: Rational oxytocin usage index
indicators.numerator: Total number of oxytocin vials used in labour room
indicators.denominator: Total number of deliveries conducted
indicators.formula_or_operator: Number of oxytocin doses used/Number of Deliveries conducted
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure safe oxytocin practices in the facility

indicators.name: Patient Satisfaction Score
indicators.numerator: Sum of average satisfaction score of each respondent (Average satisfaction score = sum total of scores of attributes/number of total attributes)
indicators.denominator: Total number of respondents
indicators.formula_or_operator: Mean of scores given by each patients in Patient satisfaction survey for labour room done each month on statistically adequate sample (at least 30)
indicators.significance: Indicator of patient satisfaction in labour Room

indicators.name: Bed occupancy rate for normal delivery ward
indicators.numerator: Patient bed days- midnight head count of each day added for the month for all patients Inclusion:- Total clients staying in the ward after normal deliveries Exclude head count of new-borns admitted with the mother
indicators.denominator: Total number of functional beds available for normal delivery patients multiplied by number of days in the month Exclusion:- Beds occupied by normal delivery clients designated for any other category of patients
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total Patient bed days in normal delivery ward*100/Functional bed in normal delivery ward*days in month)
indicators.significance: Indicator for Utilization of maternity ward

indicators.name: Bed occupancy rate for C-Section ward
indicators.numerator: Patient bed days- midnight head count of each day added for the month .of all patients Inclusion:- Total clients staying in the ward after C-section Exclude head count of new-borns admitted
indicators.denominator: Total number of functional beds available for caesarean patients multiplied by number of days in the month
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total Patient bed days in C-Section ward*100/Functional bed in C-Section ward*days in month)
indicators.significance: Indicator for Utilization of maternity ward for C-Section services

indicators.name: Proportion of severe anaemia cases treated with blood transfusion
indicators.numerator: Total number of pregnant women provided blood transfusion to treat severe anaemia during antenatal, intra natal or post natal care.
indicators.denominator: Total number of pregnant women admitted in the hospital
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of women provided blood transfusion/Total number of Pregnant women admitted in the hospital
indicators.source_of_data: Case sheet and Maternity ward Register
indicators.significance: Indicator for Utilization of blood transfusion services

indicators.name: Proportion of cases of High Risk pregnancy/obs complications
indicators.numerator: Total number of High risk pregnancy Inclusion:- Severe Anaemia ,PPH, PIH/Eclampsia/Pre Eclampsia, Retained Placenta, HIV Positive Pregnant women, Septic Cases, Obstructed labour including C- Section
indicators.denominator: Total number of obs cases admitted
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of high risk pregnancy cases managed/Total number of obs cases admitted
indicators.significance: Indicator for Utilization of EMoC services

indicators.name: Referral Rate
indicators.numerator: Total Number of obs cases referred to higher facility
indicators.denominator: Total number of obs cases admitted
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of obs cases referred*100/Total number of obs cases admitted
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of clinical process

indicators.name: Bed Turn over rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of discharges Inclusion:- Normal discharge, LAMA, Referral, Abscond, Deaths
indicators.denominator: Total number of beds available in maternity ward
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of discharges in the maternity ward/Total number of beds
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of clinical process

indicators.name: Discharge Rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of discharges from maternity ward Exclusion:- LAMA, abscond and deaths
indicators.denominator: Total number of obs cases admitted
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of discharges in the maternity ward/Total number of OBS cases admitted
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of clinical process

indicators.name: Number of Drugs stock out in the ward
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total Stock outs days:- Stock outs events of essential drugs added for the month Inclusion – List of Commodities Exclusion – Strikeout of any other drug (One stock out day means one drug not available in the ward for one day)
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiently availability of essential drugs in the ward

indicators.name: Average length of stay for normal delivery
indicators.numerator: Total patient Census of each day added for the month for normal delivery patients
indicators.denominator: Total no. of Discharges in the Months for normal delivery cases Inclusion- LAMA, Death, Referral and Absconding in the Month
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total Patient bed days of normal delivery cases/Total number of discharges of Normal delivery
indicators.significance: Indicator of Quality of Clinical care and infection control practices during normal delivery

indicators.name: Average length of stay for C-Section
indicators.numerator: Total patient Census of each day added for the month for C-Section delivery patients
indicators.denominator: Total no. of Discharges in the Months for C-section cases Inclusion- LAMA, Death, Referral and Absconding in the Month
indicators.formula_or_operator: All Patient bed days of C-Section cases/Total number of discharges of C-Section cases(including LAMA,abscond,Deaths,Referral)
indicators.significance: Indicator of Quality of Clinical care and infection control practices during C-Section

indicators.name: New-borns breast fed within 1 hour of birth
indicators.numerator: Total number of new-borns breast fed within 1 hour after birth
indicators.denominator: Total number of Live births
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total number of new-borns breast fed within 1 hour of birth*100/Total number of live births)
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure New-born breast fed services

indicators.name: Maternal death per 1000 deliveries
indicators.numerator: Total number of maternal death occurred in the hospital Inclusion:- All woman while pregnant or within 42 days of termination of pregnancy, irrespective of the duration and site of the pregnancy, from any cause related to or aggravated by the pregnancy or its management. Exclusion:- Maternal death due to accidental or incidental causes
indicators.denominator: Total number of obs cases admitted
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total number of maternal death*1000/Total number of obs cases admitted)
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure Quality and safe maternal health services

indicators.name: Number of adverse events per 1000 patients
indicators.numerator: Total number of adverse events Inclusion:- Needle stick injury, new-born theft/swapping, Mother and new-born falls, Medication error, animal/rodent bites
indicators.denominator: Total number of admission
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total number of incidences of adverse events/ Total Number of admission)*1000
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure safe clinical practises in Maternity ward

indicators.name: Proportion of mother given Postnatal counselling
indicators.numerator: Total number of mothers counselled after delivery
indicators.denominator: Total deliveries including normal, assisted, C-sections
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of mother counselled during post natal period/Total number of deliveries conducted
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure Quality of Post Natal counselling services

indicators.name: Time taken for initial assessment
indicators.numerator: Time taken from the moment the patient entered in maternity ward to the moment the patient's assessment done by Medical officer
indicators.formula_or_operator: Mean of time taken for initial assessment. Method:- observed for Derived sample through time motion study done on sample basis (at least 5% patients but not less than 30)
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring Quality of initial care treatment

indicators.name: LAMA Rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of patients leave against medical advice from maternity ward Exclude- Abscond, Referral cases
indicators.denominator: Total admission
indicators.formula_or_operator: (No. of LAMA Patients from maternity ward*100/Total no. of admission in maternity ward )
indicators.significance: Indicator of service quality and patient satisfaction with treatment and stay in Maternity ward

indicators.name: Patient Satisfaction score
indicators.numerator: Sum of average satisfaction score of each respondent (Average satisfaction score = sum total of scores of attributes/number of total attributes)
indicators.denominator: Total number of respondents
indicators.formula_or_operator: Mean of scores given by each patients in Patient satisfaction survey for maternity ward done each month on statistically adequate sample (at least 30)
indicators.significance: Indicator of patient satisfaction in Maternity ward

indicators.name: Proportion of JSY payment done within stay of mother at facility
indicators.numerator: Total number of pregnant women received JSY payment during stay in hospital. Inclusion:- cases of account transfer or account payee cheque
indicators.denominator: Total deliveries including normal, assisted, C-sections
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of mother who received JSY payment during her stay in the ward/Total deliveries
indicators.source_of_data: Cash Book of JSY payment & Admission Register
indicators.significance: Indicator of Promptness of JSY Payment

indicators.name: Proportion of mothers given drop back facility
indicators.numerator: Total Number of women provided drop back to home each day added for the month Exclusion – Referral transport to higher Centre
indicators.denominator: Total deliveries including normal, assisted, C-sections
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of mother provided drop back after discharge/Total number of mothers discharged
indicators.significance: Indicator of promptness of transport facility under JSSK

indicators.name: Total Admission
indicators.numerator: Total number of children admitted in NRC during the month
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of children admitted in NRC for the month to be reported
indicators.significance: Indicator for Utilization of NRC

indicators.name: Bed occupancy rate
indicators.numerator: Total patient bed days- midnight head count of each day added for the month for all children
indicators.denominator: Product of Total number of functional beds and days in the month
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total Patient bed days in NRC *100/Functional bed in NRC*days in month)
indicators.significance: Indicator for Utilization of NRC services

indicators.name: Proportion of admission by gender
indicators.numerator: Total number of female children admitted
indicators.denominator: Total number of Male children admitted
indicators.formula_or_operator: 1. Total Number of female children admitted /Total number of male children admitted
indicators.significance: Indicator to see Utilization of NRC services by all gender

indicators.name: Proportion of BPL patients
indicators.numerator: Total number of BPL Patients admitted in NRC Inclusion:- Patients having BPL card/equivalent card
indicators.denominator: Total admissions in NRC
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total Number of BPL Patient admitted/Total admission
indicators.significance: Indicator to see Utilization of paediatric services by BPL patients.

indicators.name: Achieved target weight(15% weight gain)
indicators.numerator: Total number of child that has achieved weight gain of > 15% after admission
indicators.formula_or_operator: Number of children, who has achieved more than 15% weight after admission in NRC
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficient achievement of NRC

indicators.name: Down time critical equipment
indicators.numerator: Total number of days equipment are not functional during the month Inclusion:-Glucometer, Weighing scales (Digital) ,infantometer,Stadiometer, resuscitation equipment, Suction equipment are non functional over the month
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of break down days added for NRC
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of critical equipment

indicators.name: Bed Turn over rate
indicators.numerator: Total discharges from NRC Inclusion:-Normal discharge, LAMA, , Referral, Abscond, Deaths
indicators.denominator: Total number of functional beds available in NRC
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of discharges from the SNCU/Total number of beds
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of clinical process

indicators.name: Referral Rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of patients referred to higher centre Exclude:- LAMA, Abscond,
indicators.denominator: Total admissions in NRC
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of children referred from NRC/Total number of children admitted in NRC
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of clinical process

indicators.name: Discharge Rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of discharges from NRC Exclude- LAMA,, Abscond, Referral
indicators.denominator: Total admissions in NRC
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total number of discharges in the NRC*100/Total number of admission in the NRC)
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of clinical process

indicators.name: Defaulter Rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of defaulter cases in the month. Inclusion:-Number of defaulter will be a child with SAM admitted to the ward but absent (from the ward) for three consecutive days without been discharged.
indicators.denominator: Total Exit:-Includes recovered , defaulter & death
indicators.formula_or_operator: Number of beneficiaries that defaulted during the reporting period/Total exits
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of clinical process

indicators.name: Relapse Rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of relapse cases in the month Inclusion:- A patient who has been discharged as cured from the programme within the last 2 months but is again eligible for admission to NRC
indicators.denominator: Total Exit:-Includes recovered , defaulter & death
indicators.formula_or_operator: Number of beneficiaries that relapsed during the reporting period/Total exits
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of clinical process

indicators.name: Average waiting time for admission (Min)
indicators.numerator: Waiting time:- Time of arrival of patient in NRC till admission
indicators.formula_or_operator: Mean of waiting time for the derived sample observed in time motion study done on sample basis (at least 5% patients but not less than 30)
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring promptness of services delivery

indicators.name: Average length of stay in weeks
indicators.numerator: Total patient bed days in NRC
indicators.denominator: Total number of discharges X days in the week
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total Patient bed days in NRC/Total number of discharges*7
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring Quality of care in NRC

indicators.name: Death rate following discharges from NRC
indicators.numerator: Total number of deaths after discharge from NRC
indicators.denominator: Total number of discharges
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of deaths after discharge from NRC/ Total number of Discharges
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring safe clinical practices

indicators.name: Recovery rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of beneficiaries that have reached discharge criteria within the reporting month
indicators.denominator: Total Exit:-Includes recovered , defaulter & death
indicators.formula_or_operator: number of beneficiaries that have reached discharge criteria within the reporting period/Total exits
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring Quality of NRC Services

indicators.name: Proportion of asphyxiated new-born children admitted out of deliveries conducted at facility
indicators.numerator: Total number of birth asphyxia cases admitted Inclusion:-Presence of any one of the following:- 1. Delayed cry 2. Need for assisted ventilation at birth 3. APGAR <3 at 1 minute 4. APGAR <5 at 5 minute delivered in the facility
indicators.denominator: Total number of deliveries conducted in the facility
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of asphyxiated new-born children admitted/ Total number deliveries conducted in the facility
indicators.source_of_data: New Born case Record Sheet and Labour Room Register
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure safe birth practices

indicators.name: Adverse events reported
indicators.numerator: Total number of adverse events Inclusion:-Baby theft cases, falls, wrong drug administration, needle stick injury, absconding etc. detected
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of incidences of adverse events
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure safety in NRC

indicators.name: LAMA Rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of patients left against medical advice from NRC Exclude- Abscond, Referral cases
indicators.formula_or_operator: (No. of LAMA Patients from NRC/Total no. of admission in NRC )*100
indicators.significance: Indicator of service quality and patient satisfaction with treatment and stay in NRC

indicators.name: Attendant Satisfaction score
indicators.numerator: Sum of average satisfaction score of each respondent (Average satisfaction score = sum total of scores of attributes/number of total attributes)
indicators.formula_or_operator: Mean of scores given by each attendant in Patient satisfaction survey for NRC done each month on statistically adequate sample (at least 5% patients but not less than 30)
indicators.significance: Indicator of attendant satisfaction in NRC

indicators.name: Bed occupancy rate
indicators.numerator: Total Patient bed days (Midnight head count of each day added for the month of all patients)
indicators.denominator: Product of Total number of functional beds and days in the month
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total Patient bed days in Paedia ward *100/Functional bed in paedia ward*days in month)
indicators.significance: Indicator for Utilization of Paediatric ward

indicators.name: Proportion of mothers given nutritional counselling
indicators.numerator: Total number of mothers/attendant counselled for nutrition
indicators.denominator: Total number of admission in paedia ward
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of mothers or attendants counselled for nutrition/Total admission
indicators.significance: Indicator for Utilization of counselling services

indicators.name: Number of paediatric admission per 1000 indoor admission
indicators.numerator: Total admission in paediatric ward
indicators.denominator: Total admission of Hospital
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total number of Paediatric cases admitted*1000/Total number of admission in the hospital)
indicators.significance: Indicator for Utilization of paediatric services

indicators.name: Proportion of female patient
indicators.numerator: Total number of female child admitted in paediatric ward
indicators.denominator: Total admission in Paediatric ward
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total Number of female Patient admitted in paedia ward/Total admission in paedia ward
indicators.significance: Indicator to see Utilization of paediatric services by female patients

indicators.name: LAMA Rate for female patient
indicators.numerator: Total female child leaves against medical advice from paediatric ward Exclude- Abscond, Referral, cases
indicators.denominator: Total admission of female child
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total Number of female LAMA Patient in paedia ward *100/Total female admission in paedia ward)
indicators.significance: Indicator to see Utilization of paediatric services by female patients

indicators.name: Proportion of BPL Cases
indicators.numerator: Total number of BPL Patients admitted in paediatric ward Inclusion:- Patients having BPL card/equivalent card
indicators.denominator: Total admission in Paediatric ward
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total Number of BPL Patient admitted/Total Number of patient admitted in Paedia ward)
indicators.significance: Indicator to see Utilization of paediatric services by BPL patients.

indicators.name: Referral Rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of patients referred to higher centre from Paedia ward Exclude:- LAMA, Abscond
indicators.denominator: Total admission in Paediatric ward
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of Patient referred from paedia ward/Total number of Patient admitted in Paedia ward
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of clinical process

indicators.name: Bed Turn over rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of discharges Inclusion:-Normal discharge, LAMA, Referral, Abscond, Deaths
indicators.denominator: Total number of beds available in paedia ward
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of discharges from the paedia ward/Total number of beds
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of clinical process

indicators.name: Number of Drugs stock out in the paediatric ward
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total Stock outs days:- Stock outs events of essential drugs added for the month Inclusion – List of Commodities Exclusion – Strikeout of any other drug (One stock out day means one drug not available in the ward for one day)
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiently availability of essential drugs in the ward

indicators.name: Discharge Rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of discharges Exclusion:-LAMA, Referral, Abscond, Deaths
indicators.denominator: Total admission
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of discharges in the paedia ward/Total number of admission in the Paedia ward
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring efficiency of clinical process

indicators.name: No. of new-born/child resuscitated
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of Resuscitated child for the month to be reported
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure Quality of resuscitation services

indicators.name: Average length of stay
indicators.numerator: Total Patient bed days (Midnight head count of each day added for the month of all patients)
indicators.denominator: Total no. of Discharges in the Months Inclusion- LAMA, Death, Referral and Absconding in the Month
indicators.formula_or_operator: All Patient bed days in paedia ward/Total number of discharges
indicators.significance: Indicator of Quality of Clinical care and infection control practices

indicators.name: Death Rate

indicators.name: Risk adjusted mortality rate/ Standard Mortality rate
indicators.numerator: The Standardized Mortality Ratio (SMR) is defined as the ratio of the observed mortality rate to the expected mortality rate. This permits performance-based comparisons of ICUs by adjusting for disease category and severity of physiological derangement. The reference values for the expected mortality rates are obtained by documenting mortality rates of patients from a large number of ICUs in a specific population. These are then stratified based on disease categories and within multiple outcome score bands of standard ICU scoring systems. If the SMR for an ICU is <1, then the outcomes for that unit are interpreted to be better than the overall outcomes of the reference set used to develop the scoring system. Alternatively, an SMR of >1 signifies that the observed mortality rate is higher than the expected mortality rate, suggesting that the quality of care needs to be improve
indicators.denominator: All patients admitted in intensive care units
indicators.formula_or_operator: Risk-adjusted Mortality 1 = (Observed Rate/Risk-adjusted expected Rate) X100 Observed rate = Actual death in ICU/institution. Risk adjusted expected rate = Predicted death rate by predictive Model
indicators.source_of_data: Hospital record for the observed mortality
indicators.significance: Risk adjusted mortality rate/Standard mortality rate is a very useful parameter, often used to compare outcomes in two or more groups under study. It also gives an opportunity to individual ICUs for improving the processes and techniques.

indicators.name: Turn around time for X-ray film development

indicators.name: X-ray done per radiographer

indicators.name: Proportion of X-ray for which report is signed by radiologist

indicators.name: Proportion of scans for which F-form is filled out of pregnant women scanned

indicators.name: Examination demography

indicators.name: Report correlation rate

indicators.name: Number of adverse events per 1000 patients

indicators.name: Number of events of over limit of radiation exposure

indicators.significance: Indicator to measure quality of radiation exposure and patient safety

indicators.name: Average Waiting time at radiology
indicators.numerator: Waiting time :-Time taken from the moment the patient joined the queue to the moment X-Ray taken
indicators.formula_or_operator: Mean of waiting time for the derived sample observed in time motion study done at peak hours on sample basis (at least 5% patients but not less than 30

indicators.name: Average Waiting time at USG

indicators.formula_or_operator: Mean of waiting time for the derived sample observed in time motion study done at peak hours on sample basis (at least 5% patients but not less than 30
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring service Quality of radiology department

indicators.name: Number of stock out incidences of X-ray films

indicators.name: Percentage of drugs available against essential drug list for OPD

indicators.name: Percentage of drugs available against essential drug list for IPD
indicators.numerator: Total number of essential drugs available in indoor department

indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total number of essential drugs available in IPD *100/Total number drugs in EDL)

indicators.name: Expenditure on drugs procured by local purchase for BPL patients

indicators.name: Number of stock out situations in vital category medicines

indicators.name: Turn around time for dispensing medicine at pharmacy

indicators.name: % of expired during the months

indicators.name: Proportion of prescription found prescribing non generic drugs
indicators.numerator: Total number of prescription found with brand name during prescription audit
indicators.denominator: Total number of prescriptions audited during the month (at least 5% of prescriptions but not less than 30)
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of prescription found with brand name during prescription audit/Total number of prescription audited
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure adherence to generic drugs prescription

indicators.name: Number of adverse drug reaction per thousand patients
indicators.numerator: Total number of adverse drug reaction events reported
indicators.denominator: Total number of patients admitted in the hospital
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total number of adverse drug reaction events reported*1000/Total number of patients admitted
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure Safe drug administration practices

indicators.name: Antibiotic rate
indicators.numerator: Total number of prescription with antibiotics prescribed during prescription audit

indicators.name: Percentage of irrational use of drugs/over prescription

indicators.significance: Indicator of prescription practices and adherence to Standard treatment Guidelines

indicators.name: Number of cases for which medical audit done

indicators.name: Number of cases for which death audit done

indicators.name: Diet Index
indicators.numerator: Total number of diets provided during the month for all patients Inclusion:- Normal and Special diet

indicators.formula_or_operator: Total Number of diets provided during the month/Patient bed days
indicators.source_of_data: Diet Register and Mid Night census
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure utilization of Dietary department of the hospital

indicators.name: Proportion of Maternal deaths audited
indicators.numerator: Total number of maternal death audit done
indicators.denominator: Total number of maternal deaths at the facility
indicators.formula_or_operator: Total number of maternal death audited /Total number of maternal deaths (All maternal deaths are required to be audited)
indicators.source_of_data: Death Register, Maternal death audit register
indicators.significance: Indicator of adherence to maternal death audit process

indicators.name: Proportion of New-born deaths audited

indicators.significance: Indicator of adherence to new-born death audit process

indicators.name: Cycle for laundry services
indicators.formula_or_operator: Average time taken between the dispatch of dirty linen and receiving of clean linen
indicators.significance: Indicator to measure efficiency of Laundry department

indicators.name: Proportion of Special diets
indicators.numerator: Total number of special diets served Inclusion:- Diabetic diet, liquid diet, semisolid diet, renal diet, low salt/potassium diet, low fat diet etc.

indicators.significance: Indicator to measure provision of special diets to the patients

indicators.name: Medical Audit score

indicators.significance: Indicator to measure clinical care

indicators.name: Death Audit score

indicators.significance: Indicator to measure clinical care

indicators.name: Waiting time for getting handicap certificate

indicators.name: Waiting time for getting death certificate

indicators.name: Patient feedback on cleanliness of linen

indicators.significance: Indicator to measure patient satisfaction with respect to linen service of hospital

indicators.name: Patient feedback on Quality of food
indicators.numerator: Sum of scores obtained in IPD patient satisfaction survey on attribute related to Quality of food

indicators.significance: Indicator to measure patient satisfaction with respect to dietary service of hospital

indicators.name: Proportion of non-MLC cases

indicators.significance: Indicator to measure cases of Non MLC

indicators.name: Occupancy rate of cold Storage for dead bodies
indicators.numerator: Total dead body days in cold storage (total dead body count of each day added for the month)

indicators.name: Mean Storage time for dead body in cold storage

indicators.name: Waiting time for getting post mortem report in MLC cases

indicators.name: Waiting time for carrying out post mortem
indicators.formula_or_operator: Time taken between the receipt of dead body for post mortem till the time post mortem conducted (observed in time motion study done on sample basis -at least 5% of dead bodies)
indicators.significance: Indicator for measuring service Quality for doing post mortem

indicators.name: Bed Occupancy Rate
indicators.numerator: Total Patient bed days (Midnight head count of each day added for the month of all patients)
indicators.denominator: Product of Total number of functional beds in the hospital and days in the month
indicators.formula_or_operator: (Total Patient bed days *100/Functional beds*days in month)
indicators.significance: Indicator for Utilization of Hospital Indoor services

indicators.name: Number of total admissions per thousand population
indicators.numerator: Total number of admissions

indicators.name: IPD per thousand Population

indicators.name: OPD Consultation Per thousand Population
